title: Kickboxer
tagline: Bangkok. A brother to avenge. Glass on the ropes.
about: After Tong Po cripples his brother in a Bangkok ring, Kurt Sloane learns Muay Thai from a hermit master to fight him the ancient way.
cue: Serve the crying tiger beef when Kurt steps into the ring with Tong Po.

    Drinking snacksTong Po's crying tiger beef with jaewTong Po the Tiger kicks the concrete pillar. Charred rump, smoky chilli and lime dip.How to make it600g beef rump steak2 tbsp soy sauce1 tbsp oyster sauce1 tbsp brown sugar2 tbsp jasmine rice2 tbsp fish sauce3 limes1 tsp chilli flakes2 red shallots, thinly sliced1/2 cup coriander and mint leaves1 baby cos lettuce, leaves separatedRub the steak with the soy, oyster sauce and half the sugar and leave for 15 minutes.Toast the rice in a dry pan until deep golden, then grind it to a coarse powder.For the jaew, mix the fish sauce, juice of 2 limes, the rest of the sugar, chilli flakes, shallots and a spoon of the ground rice.Grill the steak over high heat until charred outside and pink inside, then rest it for 5 minutes.Slice thinly, scatter with herbs and the rest of the rice powder, and serve with lettuce cups, lime wedges and the jaew.Banana blossom and prawn saladKurt kicks the banana tree down. Banana blossom, prawns, chilli jam, coconut.How to make it1 banana blossom (or 2 cups shredded wombok)2 limes300g cooked prawns, peeled2 tbsp Thai chilli jam2 tbsp fish sauce1 tbsp palm sugar, grated3 tbsp coconut cream3 tbsp shredded coconut3 tbsp roasted peanuts, chopped1/2 cup mint and coriander leavesPeel off the tough outer layers of the blossom, slice the pale heart very thinly and drop it into water with the juice of a lime.Toast the coconut in a dry pan until golden.Whisk the chilli jam, fish sauce, sugar, coconut cream and the juice of the other lime.Drain the blossom well and toss with the prawns, dressing and herbs.Pile onto a plate and finish with the peanuts and toasted coconut.Fried peanuts with lime leaf and chilliOn the bar before the brawl starts.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.PlatesPedicab pad kra pao with a crisp fried eggNow you drive me in Pedicab. Chilli pork, holy basil, jasmine rice.How to make it600g pork mince5 garlic cloves4 bird's eye chillies2 tbsp vegetable oil, plus extra for the eggs2 tbsp oyster sauce1 tbsp fish sauce1 tbsp soy sauce2 tsp white sugar2 cups holy basil or Thai basil leaves4 eggs2 cups jasmine riceRinse the rice and cook it with 3 cups of water, covered, then rest it off the heat.Pound the garlic and chillies to a rough paste.Fry the paste in the oil in a smoking wok for 30 seconds, add the pork and stir-fry until browned and catching.Add the oyster, fish and soy sauces and the sugar, toss, then wilt in the basil.Fry the eggs in hot oil, spooning it over until the edges are crisp and the yolks still soft, and serve on the rice and pork.White warrior green curry of chickenThe crowd chants Nack Suk Cao. Thigh, Thai eggplant, basil, coconut.How to make it700g chicken thigh fillets, sliced4 tbsp green curry paste400ml coconut milk250ml coconut cream6 Thai eggplants, quartered (or 1 small eggplant, diced)4 kaffir lime leaves, torn2 tbsp fish sauce1 tbsp palm sugar, grated1 cup Thai basil leaves1 long red chilli, sliced2 cups jasmine ricePut the rice on to cook.Boil the coconut cream in a wok until it splits and the oil shows, then fry the curry paste in it until fragrant.Add the chicken and stir to coat, then add the coconut milk, eggplant and lime leaves and simmer until the chicken is cooked.Season with the fish sauce and sugar, stir in the basil and top with the chilli.Serve with the rice.SweetsMango sticky rice with smashed palm sugar glassHemp rope, resin and broken glass. Coconut sticky rice, mango, shards of toffee.How to make it300g glutinous rice, soaked overnight400ml coconut milk100g caster sugar, plus 150g for the glass1/2 tsp salt1 tsp cornflour2 ripe mangoes2 tsp toasted sesame seedsDrain the rice and steam it in a lined steamer until tender and sticky.Meanwhile warm 300ml coconut milk with the 100g sugar and the salt, pour most of it over the hot rice, cover and leave to soak in.Melt the 150g sugar in a dry pan until amber, pour thinly onto baking paper, scatter with sesame and leave to set hard, then smash into shards.Simmer the rest of the coconut milk with the cornflour until thick for the topping.Serve the rice with sliced mango, the thick coconut and shards of glass stuck in the top.Behind the barMekhong bucket with lime and sodaXian gets Kurt drunk before the bar fight. Thai spirit, lime, Red Bull, soda, ice.How to make it200ml Mekhong Thai spirit2 limes, cut in wedges250ml Red Bull500ml soda water3 cups iceSqueeze the lime wedges into a small ice bucket or large jug and drop them in.Fill with ice, pour in the Mekhong and Red Bull and top with soda.Stir and serve with a straw each.Singha beer over iceIce in the glass, the Bangkok way.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
